title: 1904 people walk round stoops and railings, and draft doors open
items: Prairie Avenue residents no longer walk through stoops, area walls, iron railings or bays: every walk out of a door and along a frontage keeps a skirt's width off them.
People stepping aside or gathering to talk are never placed inside a stoop or railing.
Seven more draft houses' front doors swing open as their people go in and out, and every door's answering place stands on open ground.
